claims.text: The data comes from various sources including news websites (38%), false news and satirical articles (30%), and social media (11%).
The corpus is based on data collected by Snopes fact-checkers and includes documents from discussion blogs, news, and social media.
The corpus consists of validated claims and over 14,000 documents annotated with evidence.
